note: 7-day sweep across web-indexed LinkedIn (Google/Bing only), Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, CareerBuilder, ACC Jobline, Robert Half Legal, Major Lindsey & Africa, FractionalJobs.io, and JobLeads. Net-new inventory was thin this run: the legal-freelance market is heavily covered by the last ~6 weeks of daily runs, and most surface results were aggregator/salary hubs (ZipRecruiter salary pages, Indeed flexible-jobs landing pages, Glassdoor counts) or recurring employers already captured (Axiom, Latitude Legal, Ontra, Beacon Hill, aVenture, Major Lindsey & Africa, Larson Maddox, Sleep Doctor, etc.), which were deduplicated out against the last 14 legal-freelance reports. Four genuinely new qualifying leads (all Priority B, combined 60-72) surfaced. Robert Half staffing reqs and the Tower Legal temp posting read as rolling/evergreen rather than posted-in-last-72h, so recency was scored conservatively (0). Reported honestly rather than padding with weak or duplicate leads.
